title: This is the type of show i want to take over the NYC theatre scene #b...
transcript: okay ignore what I'm wearing I just did P90X so my arms won't look like noodles for the first time in my life I feel like everybody thinks I'm very negative about everything that's happening in the musical theatre scene and to be fair I'm negative about a lot of it and I'm negative about a lot of it because I'm very very very passionate about the art form I want to praise a new musical I listened to this morning it blew my mind it is one of the best scores I've heard and I don't know how many years and it is the unauthorized and untitled Hunter s Thompson musical by Joe Iconis that is currently doing its first full production in California now to preface I was no fan of Be More Chill I saw the first preview I walked in blind to it I just got a cheap ticket and there were just children screaming everywhere and they were stapling pieces of bread to walls outside of the theater and I was like what's going on I haven't really investigated any other Joe works but this score blew me away I mean knocked me over it's one of my favorite scores maybe since passing strange it might be my favorite score since passing strange it is truly something new something I've been wanting for a long time from musical theater so please Joe and company tighten this sucker up and bring it to New York also Joe and company one time I was hospitalized because I was taking two trips inside of my head using ]a powerful substance featured in your musical]a week and it did not work well for my brain I blew my head so if you need someone to run things by as a cultural 💫💫💫 reference I'm here for you let me know I can be your psychedelic consultant
